## Checklist

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and followed it (required)
- [ ] This PR does one thing and links its issue (required)
- [ ] Tests, typecheck and lint pass locally (required)
- [ ] I added or updated tests for the change, or explained above why none are needed (required)
- [ ] No secrets, keys, tokens or personal data are in the code, commits or screenshots (required)
- [ ] I agree to the contributor licence agreement in CONTRIBUTING.md (required)
- [ ] I did not delete, skip or weaken tests to make checks pass (required)
- [ ] Bug fix: includes a test that fails without the fix
- [ ] Docs updated (README, docs/, CHANGELOG) where behaviour changed
